preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 for x in [n, k])
preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers
n and k are within the bounds 1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100000
n and k have the same parity (n mod 2 = k mod 2)

postconditions.description: The output string s has length exactly n

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output string s consists only of '0' and '1' characters

postconditions.expression: any(len(t) == k and all(s.count(t) == 1 for t in [s[i:i+k] for i in range(len(s) - k + 1) if len(s[i:i+k]) == k]) and all(s.count(t) != 1 for t in [s[i:i+l] for l in range(1, k) for i in range(len(s) - l + 1)]) for s in [stdout.strip()])
postconditions.description: The output string s has a minimal unique substring of length exactly k (no unique substring of length < k exists, and at least one unique substring of length k exists)
